integrity: The proof is an exact local change-of-variables argument for the source coefficient formula. The tail constant comes from the two-dimensional singular corner where consecutive evaluation times approach the shared boundary. A standalone numerical integration only checks the formula on one deterministic-boundary instance.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the distribution of each fixed momentum coefficient in the two anytime schedules. It does not imply independence across time, does not contradict the source convergence theorem, and does not establish numerical instability of the iterates.
title: Exact Pareto-two tail for randomized heavy-ball momentum coefficients
